title: Statistical Impossibility and Possibility of Aligning LLMs with Human Preferences: From Condorcet Paradox to Nash Equilibrium

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and mathematical analysis of preference collapse using Condorcet cycles and Nash equilibria to demonstrate how standard RLHF reward models suppress minority preferences, supplemented by empirical evaluation of policy win rates to show the efficacy of a non-reward-based alignment method (Nash-RS).
